meta.goal: Long-endurance drone battery: energy density >= 446.18 Wh/kg, 5C discharge with capacity retention >= 90%, cell mass <= 40 g.
meta.thresholds_source: task text verbatim: 446.18 Wh/kg, 90% 5C retention, 40 g mass
meta.stage1_vacuous_note: Task text names no new materials/additives/electrolyte -> start_stage=3 (cell design); stage1 molecular criteria empty; system candidates skip the molecular funnel per protocol.
meta.stage3_defaults_note: Task text silent on thermal red line and plating -> protocol defaults applied: plated=false (Stage 4 fast-charge exam, auto-derived from anode_potential_v min<0) and T_max_K max 333.15 K (60 C operating red line).
meta.retention_definition: capacity_retention_5c = Q(5C_discharge, dfn) / Q(1C_discharge, dfn) with identical params, computed mechanically by the agent from two run-pyamm outputs and written to a derived JSON judged by log-evaluate.
meta.mass_definition: cell mass = calc-energy mass_kg (contract formula: sum over layer thickness x (1-porosity) x density x area; electrolyte excluded - calc-energy output electrolyte_included:false).
meta.base_reason: Task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite teaching parameterization), recorded per Section 1.5.

ablation.exploration_force_source: task text: 'exploration_force switch OFF - no forced 2-4 architecture variants per round; propose architecture variants at relevant moments only, free exploration'

freedoms.note: Task text declares none of the five degree-of-freedom categories; zero-interaction rule + t1_r1 lesson -> widest interpretation applied with record.
